cases.rationale: Actual players and spectators are visible. The catcher wears a distinct fielding mitt, and the dugout contains a long bench seat beneath the seated players. The bat, helmets and fences do not establish other defined objects. I considered every definition over the whole crop; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A person in a white shirt fills the crop, with a long gray outdoor bench visible across the lower background. The raised hand does not contain an identifiable racket or disc. Trees and lawn are unpotted vegetation. Every definition was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The foreground tennis player and background spectators are actual people. The curved strung racket head and handle identify a tennis racket. Clothing, headband and the blurred spectator legs do not identify bags or furniture. Every definition was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An actual black-and-white dog lies on the stained floor; its collar is not a tie. At the far left only a narrow curved white porcelain fixture edge is visible. Its severe truncation leaves toilet (61) versus sink (71) identity unresolved, so both are unclear. The tiled wall and damaged door add no other identifiable category object. Every definition was considered.

Two actual people lie on a rug in front of a standalone television; people shown within its screen are excluded as depicted content. Actual book spines fill the shelf below. A narrow-neck bottle and a white drinking cup sit on the left side table, and a wooden upholstered individual chair is visible at the left. The separate gray upholstered furniture is too cropped to resolve whether it includes a couch (57). The tiny framed object at the upper-right mantel could be a clock (74), but its face lacks adequate detail. Tables here are side/coffee surfaces without dining-table context. Every definition was considered.

A child stands with a hand on a large red fire hydrant whose cap, barrel and outlet are identifiable. The small yellow road sign in the distance is not a stop sign or signal, and the dark background shapes do not identify another defined object. Every definition was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The kitchen has numerous identifiable bottles along the back counter, a small white bowl beside the saucepan, a range with a visible oven front at lower left, and a sink/faucet at the right counter edge. The broad white foreground surface is a kitchen counter. The utensils protruding near the saucepan are too small to distinguish possible knives (43) and spoons (44) from other cooking tools. The leafy greens are not identifiable broccoli or a potted plant, and pots/jars are not drinking cups or vases. Every definition was considered.

A full-size passenger police car occupies the foreground, with other passenger cars across the street. A white fire hydrant stands at the curb. The police roof light bar is vehicle equipment rather than a traffic signal, and the door emblems do not count as actual depicted objects. Every definition was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A person's torso and arm sit behind an eating table. Two handled mugs, a lidded takeaway cup and a tall handleless drinking glass satisfy cup. A fork with tines, table knives and a spoon are visible. The bagel contains a distinct filling layer and therefore is a sandwich; its ring-shaped bread is not a donut. Plates and saucers are not bowls. Every definition was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An actual person stands with an outstretched empty hand on open grass. There is no identifiable flying disc, carried bag or sports equipment within the crop. The surrounding trees and shrubs lack pots. Every definition was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

The bathroom contains an identifiable wall-mounted sink with taps and drain and a toilet at lower left. Plants grow from visible containers on the shelf, and the pink dispenser has a bottle body and neck. The mirror is not a display, the washbasin is not a portable bowl, and the indistinct shelf accessories do not identify toothbrushes or drinking vessels. Every definition was considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

This kitchen crop shows a sink and dish rack with a white cup and a small open bowl among the plates, a plant in a visible pot at the window, and bound books on the upper-left shelving. The fine utensil shapes in the rack are insufficient to resolve forks (42), knives (43), or spoons (44), so these remain unclear. A tiny narrow container on the left shelf may be a bottle (39), but neck detail is inadequate. The green unit is sink cabinetry, and the dark apparatus at right does not identify an oven or computer keyboard. Every definition was considered.
